tools.name: search_units
tools.description: Hybrid (dense + BM25) search over the package's units for the active pipeline version. Returns the top K units with normalised scores, fields and page regions when available.

k.description: Results to return; default from config (5).

items.description: Unit types. v1.0 produces only CHUNK; v2.3.1 produces the evidence-unit types.

tools.name: graph_hop
tools.description: Run an approved SPARQL template over the package's knowledge graph (FIBO subset, DoCO, SKOS, PROV-O, fin:). Returns rows, a computed total when the template has one, and operand lineage.

params.description: Template parameters: field_lookup_v1 {concept, borrower?}; concept_by_label_v1 {label}; unit_lineage_v1 {unitId}; qi_sum_w2_box1_v1 {} (taxYear optional); coupon_terms_v1 {security} (a security identifier such as XS-2031).

tools.name: get_region
tools.description: Resolve the page region for a unit or one of its fields: page, bbox in PDF points (top-left origin), page size.

tools.name: doc_status
tools.description: Ingestion status of the package's documents for the active pipeline version.
